questions.q: An object is thrown vertically upward with speed $v_0$. Neglecting air resistance, after what time does it return to the launch point?
questions.e: The rise time is $v_0/g$ and the fall time is the same: $2v_0/g$ in total.

questions.q: A car starts from rest with constant acceleration and covers a distance $d$ in the first time interval $t$. What distance does it cover in the next interval $t$?
questions.e: $s\propto t^2$: in time $2t$ it covers $4d$, so in the second interval $4d-d=3d$.

An object falls freely from height $h$. What fraction of the total fall time is spent covering the second half of the distance?
questions.e: The total time is $\sqrt{2h/g}$ and the first half takes $\sqrt{h/g}$; the fraction is $1-1/\sqrt2\approx0.29$.

questions.q: Two trains move toward each other at 20 m/s and 30 m/s. If they are 1 km apart, after how many seconds do they meet?
questions.e: The relative speed is 50 m/s: $1000/50=20$ s.
